## What

Discharges **DF-S1.20-1**'s three residual control-plane legs and
closes **BL-14**:

**1. `steerable` delegation legs on a real run.** A model call on the
configured `delegate_surface_id` mints `control.delegate.proposed` —
a new registered durable audit class — before execution (CC3). The
driver runs admitted delegates through `DelegatePort::delegate` over a
`StoreSeam` (the run's `Store` + writer lease): `UnbackedPort` without
a seam, `delegation_unavailable` without the R-2.6.3 binding,
`missing_delegation_reason` at `check` (the pre-existing contract now
exercised), substrate refusals returned to β as
`EnvelopeSignal::Refused`. `SpawnDelegatePort`
(`crates/hh-orchestrator/src/delegate.rs`) parses through the canonical
`SubagentSpec` codec and invokes the real `hh_subagent::spawn` under
`ParentBinding` — attenuation/budget/depth stay in the child-lease
substrate (CC2), the decision `EventRef` is the idempotency key.

**2. `woken{peer_message}` interpretation.** The steerable interpreter
selects on the wakeup *trigger*, not the delivery lane: a peer-message
occurrence folds into the next `propose` as a context artefact — the
S4.8 messaging consumer half — never a steer cue; the same trigger on
the steer lane still steers (CC1 — one interpretation table). Pending
delegate proposals fold into admitted `delegate` decisions with reason
and spec.

**3. `hh/workflow@1`/`hh/program@1` real-run semantics.** Both variants
bind the one `PlanWalker` (`crates/hh-control/src/walk.rs`) — the
sequential `RuntimePlan/1` interpreter under `compute_policy = static`:
step/invoke/branch-on-validator (fail-closed)/loop/delegate/stop-rule
semantics, `state.extension.walk` position with checkpoint/restore,
typed `missing_procedure`/`walk_position_corrupt`/model-emitted-plan
refusals. `variant_for` stays exact — unknown refs answer `None`; the
staged park is retired for both variants (ADR-0256 D6 superseded as
the ticket names).

**4. `hh-embed` arm projection + seam.** `arm_driver`/
`arm_resume_driver` bind the *armed* variant's own boundary preset (the
shared react fallback is gone) and project `ctx.plan` for
`requires.procedure` variants through `link` → `lower_native` over the
sealed definition — the one honest producer; a doc that won't lower
refuses the arm typed (ADR-0355 D2). `KernelSink::store_seam` wires
embedded runs to the delegate port.

Regression updates: `hh-control r2_6` staged-variant assertions
rewritten to the walker vocabulary (19/19); no other suite touched.
